title: Settling the Balance Given Up When a Healthy Options Card Programme Closes
content:
This is the settlement basis on which the balance given up at the closure of a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programme is worked out.

**The amount.** The balance given up on the closing day is what is still standing on the card less what is kept back for card transactions made before that day which have not yet settled, never less than nothing and rounded to the nearest cent at the end and at no earlier step. The floor it is held at is 0.00 USD.

**The quantities it is built from.**

1. *What is still standing on the card.* What is still standing on the card is taken as the balance the card record shows.
2. *What has already been taken off the card.* What has already been taken off the card is taken as nothing.
3. *The closing day.* The closing day is taken as the day the member's request to close the card was taken.
4. *What is kept back.* Nothing is kept back for card transactions that have not yet settled.

**Worked through on hypothetical figures.** Take a programme whose card record shows a balance of 212.40 USD, with a request to close taken on a given day. What is still standing on the card is 212.40 USD. Nothing is kept back for transactions that have not yet settled. The balance given up on the closing day is therefore 212.40 USD, rounded to the nearest cent once at the end. Where the card record shows a balance of nothing, the same reckoning gives 0.00 USD, the figure never falling below that floor.
